skills.name: What computer science is; input, process, output

worked_example.problem: A cashier scans the price of rice, the till adds up the total, the total appears on the screen and is saved for the day’s sales. Name the four stages.
steps: Showing the total on the screen: output.
Saving it for the day’s sales: storage.

cards.idea: A computer is an electronic machine that accepts data, processes it, stores it and gives results.
example: A calculator, a phone and a laptop are all computers of a kind.

right.text: an electronic machine that accepts data, processes it, stores it and gives results

wrong.explain: A motor alone does not process data.

wrong.text: a box that only plays music
wrong.explain: A computer can do much more: it processes data.
A television shows pictures; a computer processes data.
A program is instructions; a computer is the machine that follows them.

cards.idea: Input, processing, output and storage make the information processing cycle.
Computer Science studies how to solve problems with computers, write programs and use data.
example: Writing an app to record class marks is computer science.

pick.t: typing your name on the keyboard
pick.why: Input: typing your name on the keyboard.

pick.t: the computer adding up the marks
pick.why: Processing: the computer adding up the marks.

pick.t: the printer printing the report card
pick.why: Output: the printer printing the report card.

pick.t: saving the marks on the hard disk
pick.why: Storage: saving the marks on the hard disk.

pick.t: showing the result on the screen
pick.why: Output: showing the result on the screen.

misconceptions.explain: Not that stage. Data in, work on it, results out, keep it.

questions.prompt: Which is part of computer science?
Sort these devices: input or output?
One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: A keyboard is an input device.
A printer is an output device.
A computer follows instructions called a program.
Data can be stored for later use.

wrong.text: A screen is an input device.
A computer can think and feel like a person.
wrong.explain: A computer follows instructions; it has no feelings.
Processing is working on the data; printing is output.
